messages:
Marta (growth): Heads-up  I pushed the new LaunchBoard staging build. Can folks sanity-check webinar vs inbound metric tabs? :eyes:
Ryan H: quick look  cohort toggles look neat, loading times fine.
Nelson S: I noticed an inbound attribution spike on 2025-04-11 that doesn't line up with GA, wondering if sampling changed. @Marta (growth)
Marta (growth): dashboard uses attribution_window=7d; GA export was using 14d for the demo sets. that mismatch could cause diffs.
Yasmin L: also seeing fb_campaign sometimes mapped to (not set) in the csv exports  could be trailing param issues on landing template.
Ryan H: checking logs  one of the analytics connectors had sample_rate=0.1 last week, I flipped it back yesterday.
Nelson S: ok that explains it. suggestion: add a visible sampling warning on the dashboard when sample_rate != 1.0 so stakeholders notice at-a-glance.
Marta (growth): good call. dashbot, can you surface a sampling badge when sample_rate < 1?
dashbot: automated note: sampling badge implemented on staging for LaunchBoard when sample_rate != 1.0. see /dash-config/logs/launchboard.
Ryan H: also saw webinar conversion rate dip vs prior quarter but note: our contact import had a dedupe bug previously that inflated numbers.
Yasmin L: request: surface raw_leads and deduped_leads side-by-side in the table and include source_match_rate so marketing ops can justify the change in the deck.
Marta (growth): yes — add raw_leads, deduped_leads, source_match_rate columns and include in weekly csv export.
Nelson S: and add a short attribution assumptions callout (window, last_touch vs multi_touch, sample_rate, contact-import version) near the top of the dashboard. will save repeated threads.
Ryan H: I'll add the banner and new columns  ETA EOD. putting the SQL I ran for sanity checking counts if anyone wants to run ad-hoc:
```
select date(created_at) as day, count(*) as raw_count, count(distinct email) as deduped_count
from leads
where created_at >= '2025-04-01'
group by day
order by day desc
```
Yasmin L: nice, i'll run CSV validation after deploy and surface any UTM mismatches.
Marta (growth): plan for Friday KPI sync: one-slide note about dedupe change + sampling. Ryan/Nelson/Yasmin please post confirmations here when done. :thumbsup:
Ryan H: deployed to prod  sampling banner live and new columns in exports.
Yasmin L: validated 2025-04-10 to 2025-04-14 webinar CSV vs dashboard  12 mismatches found, mostly trailing whitespace in utm_campaign. filing cleanup doc at /marketing/ops/utm-cleanup.md
Nelson S: GA crosswalk done  found 3 inconsistent event names between staging/prod, fixed mapping and deployed.
Marta (growth): perfect. we'll mention this in Friday's KPI review slide and note the mitigations. thanks team! :chart_with_upwards_trend:
